title: Austin Small Group Morning Walk
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Start your day with 20% off! Enjoy 20% off your breakfast order at Jo's Coffee (242 W. 2nd Street)- exclusive to Morning Walk guests! Just show proof of your morning walk purchase on the day of your tour to receive the discount. Then go on to discover the hidden gems of Austin, TX. Our nationally acclaimed storyteller will be your guide as you see iconic sights and hear the history of downtown Austin. Your morning walk will be highly informative and entertaining. You will fall in love with this city.
